title: Macacua orders seven BARMM agencies to submit courtesy resignations

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Bangsamoro Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua has directed the heads of seven offices and commissions in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) to submit their unconditional courtesy resignations on or before Friday, Nov. 20. In his memorandum circular issued early this week, Macacua directed the heads of the Bangsamoro Youth Commission, Bangsamoro Women Commission, Bangsamoro Sports Commission, Development Academy of the Bangsamoro, Office of the Bangsamoro Mujahideen under Special Circumstances, Commission for the Preservation of Cultural Heritage, and the Bangsamoro Economic Zone Authority to tender their courtesy resignations.
